wizard.title: Set up your site
wizard.footer: This installer locks as soon as you finish setup.
wizard.profile.title: Your public profile
wizard.profile.intro: This is how visitors will see your site. You can change it later.
wizard.profile.name: Name
wizard.profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {{max}} MB.
wizard.profile.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional. A short line about you or your blog.
wizard.profile.feedPreview: Your posts will appear below your profile.
wizard.profile.previewHint: This is how visitors will see your profile on the home page.
wizard.profile.error.photoType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
wizard.owner.title: Create your owner account
wizard.owner.intro: You will use these details to sign in and manage your site.
wizard.owner.asideDescription: The owner account signs in to the admin area to publish posts and edit your profile.
wizard.owner.privateHint: Your password is stored hashed and is never displayed again, not even on the review step.
wizard.review.intro: Check everything before you finish. You can go back and change any detail.
wizard.review.readyHint: When you finish, the installer locks and you can sign in with your owner account.
